content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Mulugu Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/mulugu. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Mulugu recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DLSA Mulugu recruitment is 05 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for which DLSA Mulugu is recruiting?
faq.answer: DLSA Mulugu is recruiting for two posts: Office Assistant/Clerk and Office Peon (Munshi/Attendant).

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by DLSA Mulugu for the Office Assistant/Clerk and Office Peon positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 34 years.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any age relaxations provided?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: 5 years for SCs/STs/BCs/EWS and 10 years for persons with physical disabilities.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Office Assistant/Clerk post?
faq.answer: For the Office Assistant/Clerk post, candidates must be a Graduate from any recognized University with computer and typing skills, including basic word processing and a typing speed of 40 WPM.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification for the Office Peon post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Office Peon post is 7th Class.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 14,000/- P.M for Office Peon to Rs. 20,000/- P.M for Office Assistant/Clerk.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website and sending the duly filled form along with required documents to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.
